free_parameters.name: loop_timeout_s
free_parameters.why: FuzzingLoop.run needs a positive time budget to enter its while loop; one second is enough for exactly one iteration because the negative call sleeps longer than that

free_parameters.name: negative_delay_s
free_parameters.why: makes the negative run's make_testcase fail after the time budget so the swallowing branch iterates exactly once and the run ends deterministically

free_parameters.name: random_seed
free_parameters.why: FuzzingLoop.run draws a fresh random seed each iteration; fixing the module RNG makes the single iteration identical across runs

execution.entry_reason: The target statement is inside FuzzingLoop.run. The Region's call_chain[0], PracticalHybridSearch.search_one, is not an ancestor of the target: it is reached inside make_testcase (via TorchModel.refine_weights), which runs before the try/except that contains the target, so calling search_one cannot execute line 179. The target's own function is called directly; only its failing callee is a declared stand-in.

mocks.reason: The target line handles exceptions raised by make_testcase. Building the real NNSmith backend/model on this CPU-only box needs a GPU compiler toolchain, so the failing callee is replaced by a stub that raises InternalError for failure_code=1 and RuntimeError otherwise; the target function and its exception-handling code stay real.
